blurb: A message template is checked as ICU MessageFormat at compile time, because a malformed one would otherwise fail only when a request rendered it. A `plural` or `select` must close its arm braces, use a known format keyword, give each arm a distinct key and have an `other` arm, which is used when no other arm matches; `#` stands for the number only inside a `plural` arm. Fix the template. Constructs the compiler does not support, such as `selectordinal` and `offset:`, are reported here too.
summary: A message template's ICU placeholder syntax is invalid — unbalanced arm braces, an unknown format keyword, `#` outside a plural arm, a missing mandatory `other` arm, or an explicitly out-of-scope construct (`selectordinal`, `offset:`/`=N`, a CLDR skeleton).
